thread:
sre-anna: :rotating_light: alert from audit pipeline - role 'analytics_read' shows elevated access to `customer_data` buckets after the RBAC refactor deploy an hour ago.

marta: copying logs? link?

sre-anna: pasted snippet:
```
{"event":"role-grant","actor":"rbac-service","role":"analytics_read","target":"team-analytics","change_by":"rbac-refactor-v2","timestamp":"2026-03-20T08:12:04Z"}
```

owen: that refactor changed role inheritance. probable cause.

kevin: is this read-only or includes object metadata with PII?

sre-anna: includes S3:GetObject and s3:GetObjectTagging. tags contain pii=true in older uploads.

marta: :grimacing: ok escalate. kevin, can you revoke the role for team-analytics now and patch policy to block GetObjectTagging on PII paths?

kevin: on it. running command:
```
rbacctl revoke-role --team analytics --role analytics_read --tx "emergency"
```

security-bot: (automated) revoke successful, audit id a-9421. triggered alert to pager.

leah: starting quick audit to see which customers affected. will run `s3 inventory` filter on tag pii=true and last-access hour.

owen: also enable KMS key access logging for those buckets, need to see decryption events. add KMS:GenerateDataKey events to audit stream.

marta: good. SLO: containment within 60m. kevin, file a rollback for RBAC refactor and pin previous mapping.

kevin: created PR #4821 to revert mapping change and added deny rule for `s3:GetObjectTagging` on bucket:customers/* with condition tag pii=true. linking in ticket.

auditor-bot: (note) created incident I-2026-37, attaching initial findings.

sre-anna: next steps: 1) containment done 2) audit run in progress 3) incident review 4) postmortem and policy tests before re-deploy. Assigning owners: containment=kevin, audit=leah, rollback=owen, postmortem=marta.

marta: please add unit/regression tests to `rbac-service` for inheritance edge cases. we missed one in canary. :memo:

owen: will add mocking for inherited role chains, test matrix + regression in CI.

kevin: notes — KMS keys were fine, no cross-account decrypts were allowed. exposure limited to data returned by GetObject.

leah: initial audit shows 12 objects accessed by analytics infra in last 45m, reaching out to customers ops to notify affected tenants.

marta: thanks team. keep thread updated. incident channel will be created and consolidated there.
